How you'll impact.

Proactive 1st Level Support. You are the first point of contact for all colleagues across our global offices. By working closely with your team, you ensure fast and solution-oriented IT support, on-site and remotely.

Reliable Client Management. You manage our client devices with precision, from Windows laptops to iOS smartphones. You handle rollouts, updates, and provide troubleshooting when needed, ensuring our IT runs smoothly every day.

Strong Office Infrastructure. You take ownership of maintaining our workplace and meeting room infrastructure, whether it's hardware setup or audio-visual systems,

Hands-On Project Involvement. You contribute to change initiatives and project work, and optimizing our internal IT environment.

Ownership of Key Processes. You take responsibility for recurring operational tasks such as managing internal ordering processes and asset tracking.

Empowered by Teamwork. You’ll join a dynamic and motivated IT team that values early responsibility and shared growth. Your ideas are welcome and your impact will be visible from day one.

What you'll bring.

A completed apprenticeship as an IT specialist in system integration or IT systems electronics technician or relevant professional experience.

Proven experience in end-user support, particularly in Windows environments, experience with iOS devices is an advantage.

A conscientious and flexible working style with a strong sense of responsibility.

A genuine enjoyment in supporting colleagues with professionalism, patience, and a service mindset.

You communicate fluently in English and German.

What we'll offer.

From day one, we invest in your grwoth and well-being - because your success fuels ours.

- Tailored training programs and personalized coaching to help you develop your strengths, deepen your expertise, and grow with confidence.
- Flexible working models that support your personal needs, including family, life stages, and mobility preferences.
- Access to mental coaching and well-being resources that build resilience and support you to thrive - professionally and personally.
- A rewarding Employee Referral Program - because the best teams grow through trusted connections.
- Comprehensive insurance coverage for security and peace of mind.
- Individual mobility packages that support flexibility and convenience.
- Seasonal and team events to foster collaboration and celebrate success – together.

Requisition ID: 1739672

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Working together to make the world a little bit better every day. This is our purpose at EY and as a team we go all in to work towards our bold ambition: to create long-term value and growth – for our clients, our people and society. Our network of around 400,000 people around the world offers you every opportunity to grow, develop, specialize and pursue your professional strengths and interests. We believe that the right career path is as individual as you are.

Your role
Within People Advisory Services Tax, we support organizations in managing and transforming their global mobility programs. Our integrated approach brings together hands-on operational assignment delivery with strategic mobility transformation, helping clients provide an effective employee experience while continuously evolving how mobility operates. We are looking for a (Senior) Consultant to join our Mobile Talent Operate and Mobility Transformation team. The role focuses on the end-to-end assignment lifecycle, while also supporting strategic transformation projects that shape the future of global mobility. Your wide-ranging responsibilities in our team will include:

- Act as a central point of contact for the mobility teams of multinational clients in Germany and abroad
- Coordinate services across the end-to-end assignment lifecycle, including expatriate tax, social security compliance, immigration, global compensation management and third-party relocation providers
- Prepare and review assignment-related deliverables such as cost estimates, balance sheet calculations, assignment letters and mobility documentation
- Contribute to Mobility Transformation projects, including project management activities, the development or refresh of mobility programs and assignment policies, and participation in workshops, strategic meetings and client decision-making
- Contribute to proposals, marketing materials, articles and thought leadership, and identify opportunities to provide additional services that benefit our clients

Your skillset

- A university degree in Business Administration, Management, Human Resources, or a related field, combined with a structured and organized approach to work and the ability to manage multiple projects and clients simultaneously
- A strong interest in global mobility, with enthusiasm for combining operational assignment delivery with strategic transformation initiatives, complemented by a client-focused mindset and a commitment to delivering exceptional client service
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both German and English, with strong attention to detail and the ability to deliver high-quality, accurate work, even under tight deadlines

Your mindset

- Agile: You believe that a flexible mindset is just as important for success as knowledge and skills.
- Curious: You are ambitious and committed. We are looking for people who recognize opportunities, proactively tackle challenges, and find better solutions by asking targeted questions.
- Collaborative : You value diverse perspectives and enjoy working in a team. We are looking for people to help us shape the future and create a working environment based on trust.

Your benefits
At EY, you will work in high-performing, interdisciplinary teams with innovative technologies. We support you in your various life situations with our flexible and inclusive working environment. Inspiring colleagues as well as training and development opportunities both on and off the job will empower you to grow and develop skills that will equip you for the future. We guarantee a steep learning curve.More about our benefits  .

Apply today!
You can find further information on the application process at EY on ourCareers page  .
At EY, we emb  diversity and welcome all applications. Let us know in good time if we can help you by offering an accessible application process.
Any questions? Just call +49 6196 996 10005 and our Recruitment Center will be happy to help.

Tätigkeitsbereich: IT/Telekommunikation
Fachabteilung: Operations
Gesellschaft: Mercedes pay GmbH
Standort: Berlin
Startdatum: 01.03.2026
Veröffentlichungsdatum: 01.03.2026
Stellennummer: MER0003ZHR
Arbeitszeit: Full time

Aufgaben
WHAT WE DO
Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.
ABOUT MERCEDES PAY
Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!
OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORK
We are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.

Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCE

Collaborate in a dynamic, diverse, and innovation-driven environment, where your experience and leadership will be valued.

- 
Design, set up, maintain, and continually enhance our AWS cloud resources using infrastructure-as-code and support the roll-out of new payment products and services from infrastructure perspective.

- 
Take ownership of deployments during releases and ensuring the sound functioning of CI/CD pipelines.

- 
Further develop our data pipeline with integrations to various systems.

- 
Leverage your Datadog expertise to enhance and maintain platform reliability and monitoring.

- 
Drive IT Operations during the roll-out of existing products to new markets and use-cases.

- 
Collaborate with Mercedes-Benz Group IT specialists and external providers to co-create innovative solutions.

- 
Play a key role in ensuring the operational excellence of our global payment platform.

- 
Ensure compliance of all operational products with Mercedes policies and relevant external laws and regulations.

Qualifikationen WHAT WE EXPECT

A burning passion for IT, along with an open-minded and highly motivated attitude.

- 
Successful completion of relevant studies in Computer Science or equivalent work experience.

- 
Strong solution-oriented, problem-solving and analytical skills.

- 
Proficiency in cloud service architecture best practices and experience in writing infrastructure-as-code.

- 
Skilled at Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm and experience with software programming (e.g. Java), Git SCM, and proficiency in the Atlassian Toolchain.

- 
Datadog hands-on experience, and deep understanding of features and capabilities.

- 
Experience with platform reliability best practices, set up of monitors, automated alerts and on-call service.

- 
Knowledge of IT security best practice and common standards.

- Fluent business English skills.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Modern and dynamic work environment
- Flexible and mobile working
- Attractive fitness offer
- Numerous employee discounts
- Excellent infrastructure

This is a full-time job (also suitable for part-time). We particularly welcome applications from disabled persons. Please apply online via www.group.mercedes-benz.com/careers (ID:). For questions, please don’t hesitate to contact the HR Team of Mercedes
pay GmbH: career_mercedespay@mercedes-benz.com

(Senior) IT Risk & Compliance Specialist (f/m/d)

Date: 08/20/2026
Company: SAP

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

What you'll build:

SAP SS&D (Sovereign Services & Delivery) is looking for an IT Risk & Compliance Specialist (f/m/d) to operate, audit, and further develop the secure infrastructure at our Walldorf location.

In this role, you will serve as the central authority for IT risk management, compliance assurance, and audit coordination within our highly secure operational environment. You will ensure risk-compliant governance of the local IT landscape — including the on-site Micro Data Center — with a strong emphasis on BSI IT-Grundschutz implementation, ISO 27001 adherence, and regulatory alignment.

Your responsibilities span strategic compliance planning and hands-on operational delivery: conducting internal and external audits, maintaining ISMS documentation, driving continuous improvement of the security and compliance posture, and ensuring all systems meet the strictest confidentiality and regulatory requirements for public sector and regulated industry customers.

You will act as a trusted advisor and liaison for compliance- and security-related matters at the Walldorf site, engaging with internal stakeholders, external auditors, and government authorities.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

- Leading IT compliance, audit, and GRC activities in accordance with BSI IT-Grundschutz, ISO 27001, and applicable regulatory requirements
- Preparing, conducting, and following up on audits, including evidence collection, remediation tracking, and coordination with auditors, certification bodies, and authorities
- Creating and maintaining audit-ready IT security and compliance documentation, including IT-Grundschutz and ISMS artefacts, security concepts, risk registers, operating procedures, meeting minutes, and workshop summaries
- Preparing and delivering presentations, management briefings, decision papers, and structured reports on technical, security, compliance, and project-related topics
- Identifying, assessing, documenting, and mitigating operational IT risks and supporting security accreditation processes for classified environments
- Operating and maintaining secure IT infrastructure, including virtualized environments, Active Directory, access controls, backup and recovery, hardened clients, and IT asset management
- Using SIEM solutions, to analyze logs, detect anomalies, and support incident response and forensic activities
- Supporting procurement processes by identifying requirements, coordinating with stakeholders and vendors, and initiating orders when required
- Acting as a central interface between collaborating departments by consolidating requirements, coordinating cross-functional topics, clarifying responsibilities, and ensuring effective information flow
- Coordinating external service providers and acting as the local contact for auditors, customers, stakeholders, and government authorities, including conducting infrastructure tours and technical walkthroughs

What you bring:

You are a committed and proactive IT Risk & Compliance Specialist with a strong background in secure infrastructure operations, regulatory frameworks, and audit management. Your profile should demonstrate experience in several of the following areas:

- Master's degree (or equivalent) in IT, cybersecurity, information security management, or a related field — alternatively, completed vocational training as an IT specialist (Fachinformatiker) with substantial relevant professional experience
- 4+ years of relevant working experience in IT risk, compliance, or secure IT operations
- Strong expertise in Governance, Risk Management & Compliance and Auditing Support — including hands-on experience with BSI IT-Grundschutz, ISO 27001, gap analyses, ISMS implementation, audit preparation, evidence management, and remediation tracking
- Solid understanding of Operational Risk Mitigation and Cyber Security — from identifying and treating IT risks systematically to working with BSI-certified products, secure IT architectures, SIEM platforms (ideally Splunk), and classified environments
- Proven Project Management skills — ability to plan and drive compliance and infrastructure projects independently, on time, and within defined governance frameworks
- Familiarity with AI tools in a professional context: experience applying AI-assisted automation and prototyping, agentic workflows, and context engineering to operational or compliance tasks — paired with a critical eye for AI output quality assurance and the ability to drive AI adoption within the team
- Strong communication and stakeholder skills — excellent written and spoken German and English, with the ability to build trust with internal teams, external auditors, and government authorities, and to translate complex regulatory topics into clear, actionable language for diverse audiences
- Emotional intelligence and customer orientation — empathetic and composed under pressure, with a genuine focus on delivering value and clarity to all stakeholders, even in sensitive or high-stakes situations
- Complex problem-solving mindset — structured and analytical, with the ability to diagnose root causes, evaluate trade-offs, and drive sustainable solutions in ambiguous environments
- A collaborative, hands-on, and solution-oriented working style with strong organizational skills

- Extensive experience in conducting risk analyses and risk assessments
- Knowledge of important regulatory requirements relevant to our industry such as KRITIS, NIS-2, or DORA
- Knowledge of information security standards such as e.g. ISO/IEC 27001, IT-Grundschutz and C5

Long-term experience in at least one of the following additional areas:

- Development and maintenance of compliance frameworks, requirement registers, and internal control systems
- Conducting internal and external audits
- Development and maintenance of policies

•    Independent working style, strongly developed analytical skills, and a structured as well as extremely thorough way of working

WHAT WE DO
Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.

Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

About us JUNA is on a mission to #electrifyroadfreight. Founded in
2023, we’ve had a strong start and have already deployed a
significant fleet of heavy-duty electric trucks in Europe. Our
innovative business model makes it easy and low-risk for carriers to
shift to electric logistics by offering electric trucks as a service,
a flexible pay-per-kilometer pricing structure, and access to
guaranteed utilization from large shippers. As a joint venture between
industry leaders Scania and sennder, JUNA gives customers access to
premium electric trucks and reliable revenue through access to
priority green freight. Your mission As JUNA’s (Senior) Finance
Manager, you will own the full reporting cycle across our European
entities — ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery of
financial information as we scale. You’ll work closely with external
accounting partners in multiple countries and oversee monthly
shareholder reporting. Take ownership & drive the month-end closing
process by preparing and reviewing key accounting information and
collaborating closely with external accountants to finalize the
monthly financial records. Prepare monthly accruals. Support in
preparing monthly shareholder reporting (e.g. OPEX, Vehicle P&L).
Manage communications with external accounting offices in Italy,
Netherlands, Poland, Belgium, France, and Spain. Assist external
accountants with preparation of annual reports and third-party audits.
Prepare & issue client invoices, track payment status and proactively
follow up on overdue payments. Continuously improve, streamline and
automate finance processes to drive scalability of the finance
function. What That Looks Like In the first 3–6 months: Ramp Up
Quickly: Become fully onboarded into JUNA’s finance systems and
tools, building a solid understanding of our entity structure and
reporting flows. Own Core Processes: Independently complete your first
solo month-end close accurately and on time. Build Key Relationships:
Establish reliable, trust-based working relationships with our
external accounting offices across Europe. After 12 months: Seamless
Collaboration: Work in sync with external accounting teams across all
JUNA entities, ensuring smooth coordination and minimal friction.
Trusted Owner: Be recognized as a proactive, reliable owner of the
full reporting cycle and balance sheet — the go-to person for
financial accuracy and compliance. Process Champion: Have identified
and implemented improvements to finance workflows, contributing
meaningfully to JUNA’s operational scalability. Your profile What
you bring: Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a closely related field,
coupled with 7+ years of professional experience in a relevant role.
Comfort working with external accounting partners across multiple
jurisdictions. Proficiency with accounting software and ERP systems;
experience with consolidation tools is a plus. Professional fluency in
English required; German at B2 level or above. Who you are: Sharp and
detail-oriented — you catch errors before they become problems and
take pride in numerical accuracy. Proactive and structured — you
manage your workload independently and flag issues early rather than
waiting to be asked. Reliable under deadlines — you understand that
close cycles have hard stops and you plan accordingly. Analytical
mindset — you don’t just process numbers, you understand what they
mean and can explain variances clearly. Collaborative spirit — you
work well with external partners and internal stakeholders across
different countries and functions. Bonus points if you have:
Experience with multi-entity set-up. Exposure to scaling finance
functions in a startup or fast-growth environment. Familiarity with
IFRS in addition to HGB. Experience with MOSS, Zoho Books and Atlar.
Why us? Leadership and Innovation: Work with a pioneering team
dedicated to transforming road logistics and contributing to a
sustainable future. Autonomy and Impact: We value innovation and give
you the freedom to grow in our team to make a significant impact.
Sustainability: Join a company where your work directly contributes to
reducing carbon emissions in logistics. Benefits : Join a great team
in our dog-friendly, hybrid work model with an office located at the
heart of Kreuzberg, where you’ll enjoy a relaxed, no-micromanagement
culture, regular company events, access to Urban Sports Club and L&D
budget, and an office stocked with snacks and drinks to keep you
energized. Our Company Values Think outside the truck: challenge the
internal-only status quo, prototype fast. Impact, not activity: cut
through noise, prioritize what actually matters. Own it: end-to-end
roadmap ownership, no safety net. Collaboration drives the core: daily
work with engineers, CEO, and CTO. Customer in the driver's seat:
internal or external, understand what they need. --- At JUNA, we value
authenticity, humility, and potential — so even if you don’t check
every box, we encourage you to apply. We know that diverse
backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences are what drive true
innovation. Our team is collaborative, international, and always
evolving. Come as you are — we’re excited to meet you and
hopefully welcome you on our journey to transform the logistics
industry across Europe. If you require accommodation during the hiring
process, please don’t hesitate to reach out to
mikaela.roennkvist@juna.com. Please only contact this email for
accommodation purposes.

Company Description About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards
a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and
metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades.
Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these
essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps
in. EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. The Role We are seeking a proactive,
detail-oriented and experienced Senior HR Manager (m/f/d) to join our
team in Berlin. This role will be responsible for leading key people,
compliance, and governance activities across the employee lifecycle,
ensuring that HR practices are legally compliant, operationally
effective, and aligned with organisational objectives. Acting as a
trusted advisor to managers and employees, the role provides expert
guidance on employment and employee relations matters, oversees HR
compliance and audit readiness, and drives continuous improvement of
HR policies and processes. The role also leads Health, Safety &
Environment (HSE) initiatives, ensuring compliance with German and
European regulations while promoting a safe, healthy, and engaging
workplace. Working closely with internal stakeholders, external
partners, and legal advisors, the Senior HR Manager identifies and
mitigates people-related risks, maintains strong governance
frameworks, and contributes to a positive employee experience across
the organisation. This position is ideal for an experienced HR
professional who enjoys combining hands-on operational work with
compliance oversight and strategic enhancement of HR practices. Key
Responsibilities Employment & Employee Relations Support managers on
employment-related matters and people management practices. Draft and
review employment contracts, amendments, and employment documentation.
Ensure compliance with German labor law and collective agreements
where applicable. Manage employee relations cases, including
disciplinary procedures, grievances, performance-related matters, and
workplace concerns. Partner with external legal advisors when
required. Compliance, Audits & Risk Management Conduct regular
internal HR audits to ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and
company requirements. Maintain audit-ready documentation and records.
Identify compliance risks and implement corrective actions. Support
external audits and inspections related to employment, payroll, HR
processes, and workplace regulations. Monitor and communicate changes
in employment legislation and HR compliance requirements. EU Health,
Safety & Environment Lead and coordinate health and safety initiatives
in accordance with German and European regulations. Ensure compliance
with occupational health and safety requirements. Partner with
internal stakeholders and external providers to maintain safe working
environments. Coordinate risk assessments, workplace inspections, and
mandatory training. Support wellbeing initiatives that promote
employee health and engagement. Policies, Governance & Process
Improvement Review, maintain and develop HR policies, procedures, and
employee handbook content. Ensure policies are legally compliant,
practical, and consistently applied across the organization. Drive
continuous improvement initiatives across HR operations and employee
experience. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Human
Resources, Business Administration, Law, Psychology, or a related
field. 5+ years of progressive HR experience in a generalist or HR
operations-focused role. Strong knowledge of German labour law,
employment regulations, and HR compliance requirements. Experience
managing payroll processes and working with payroll providers. Proven
experience conducting HR audits and implementing compliance
initiatives. Knowledge of occupational health and safety requirements
in Germany. Experience developing and maintaining HR policies and
procedures. Strong understanding of HRIS systems and HR data
management. Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
Fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken.
HSE certification preferred; candidates without formal qualifications
must demonstrate a willingness to complete HSE training Preferred
Qualifications Professional HR certification or relevant HR
qualification. Experience in an international or fast-growing
organization. Previous involvement in HR transformation, process
improvement, or digitalization projects. Experience working with audit
frameworks, compliance reviews, and risk management processes. Key
Competencies Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential
information. Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
Ability to balance operational execution with strategic thinking.
Process-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
Strong project management and organisational skills. Collaborative and
customer-focused approach. What We Offer Opportunity to shape and
improve HR operations in a dynamic environment. Collaborative and
international team culture. Professional development and learning
opportunities. Competitive compensation and benefits package. Flexible
working arrangements. A people-first workplace focused on inclusion,
